title: Ijwi ry'Ugushikama
intro: Uwo muntu aribukwa kubera ubwenge bwiwe n’ubuyobozi bwimbitse, agatanga impanuro zirengeye amayaruka. Amajambo yabo ni igihe c’ubumana n’akamaro ko kwemera imihezagiro n’ibigeragezo biva ku Bumana. Muhishure akaranga k’uwo mutima wubahwa.
clues: Sinari umuhanuzi, ariko ubwenge bwanje buradapfa mu Vyanditswe vy’Imana.
Impanuro nahaye umwana wanje yashimikiye cane ku gukengurukira Allah no kwirinda gushirika.
Narigishije akamaro ko gusenga, gutegeka ivyiza no kubuza ikibi.
Naragabishije ku bijanye n’ubwibone no kugendana ubujuju kw’isi.
Izina ryanje rihabwa igice cose co muri Korowani, kigashira ahabona inyigisho zanje.
Impanuro yanje yarimwo ukwihangana mu ngorane, kuko vy’ukuri ivyo biva ku bintu bikomeye kuruta ibindi vyose.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
